subject: Dedicated/Private isolation: annotated narrative & evidence raft
messages:
From: Janelle Ortiz <janelle.ortiz@acme.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: acme-security@acme.com, todd.greene@procure.acme.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: isolation narrative + diagrams for SOC 2 / SIG review

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — the team appreciated the performance numbers. Our security and procurement teams are now lining up documentation for Acme's SOC 2 intake and SIG questionnaire. Two asks from security: a concise (1–2 page) annotated narrative that explains the isolation model for Dedicated and Private deployments, and a clear network diagram showing control-plane vs data-plane boundaries and egress controls.

Timing: we have the SIG packet deadline on 2026-11-20. Can you send an initial evidence bundle (narrative + diagram + a short index of attachments) by end-of-week 2026-11-13? If you have a short FAQ or call we can add, that would help.

Appreciate it — Janelle

--
Janelle Ortiz
Senior Security Manager, Acme Corp
acme-security@acme.com

Thanks Janelle — we can do that.

Plan: I'll coordinate an initial deliverable by 2026-11-13 COB that includes:
- 2-page annotated isolation narrative scoped to Dedicated and Private deployments
- single-sheet network diagram (SVG) with legends for control-plane, data-plane, tenant fences, and egress guards
- evidence index (spreadsheet) listing supporting artifacts (config excerpts, audit log pointers, SOC 2 mappings)

Kimberly — can you assemble the narrative + network diagram export? Karthik, please add any SOC 2 mapping rows and validate the egress control language. I'll review and then ship to Acme with an offer for a 30-minute walkthrough if they want it.

Laura

--

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Draft: isolation narrative + diagrams (for review)

Attached is a first-pass bundle for Acme. Highlights and notes below.

Attachments (draft):
- redwood_isolation_narrative_draft.pdf (2 pages) — concise narrative covering:
  * Tenant isolation model (Dedicated: reserved GPU pools + tenant overlay; Private: VPC-hosted control plane with customer-managed CIDRs)
  * Control-plane partitioning and minimal service mesh endpoints used for telemetry and rollouts
  * KV-cache and prefix-caching behavior (no cross-tenant cache reuse)
  * Egress allowlist and per-tenant NAT where required
- dedicated_private_network_map_draft.svg — single-sheet diagram with legends and callouts (control-plane vs data-plane, management network, customer-managed peering)
- evidence-index_acme_draft.xlsx — index rows with suggested attachments and where to pull them from our internal drive (config snippets, SOC 2 control IDs, audit-log pointers)

Open questions I captured while drafting:
1) Acme asked about HSM/KMS separation for Private deploys — we describe KMS integration options and note customer-managed KMS is supported for Private; do we want a short sample config?
2) For Dedicated egress NAT specifics we have recent runbook excerpts (log sample + ephemeral IP ranges) — Karthik, can you confirm the suggested sample row?

I've left internal redactions where the SOC 2 artifact references production audit tokens; the final bundle will include sanitized extracts per our evidence packaging guidelines.

If that looks good I can regenerate the PDF/SVG/XLSX with final filenames and push to the shared drive link below.

- Kim

Janelle — attached is the evidence raft we discussed. The package is intentionally concise; please reply if you want any additional artifacts or if you'd like a 30-minute walkthrough this week.

Deliverables attached to this message:
- redwood_isolation_narrative_20261113.pdf — 2-page annotated narrative focusing on Dedicated and Private isolation controls and how they map to SIG/SOC 2 scoping
- dedicated_private_network_map_v2.svg — single-sheet diagram (control-plane vs data-plane, tenant overlays, management peering, egress guards)
- evidence-index_acme_20261113.xlsx — index with recommended artifact pulls and HubSpot/Drive pointers

Key callouts (summary):
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools per-customer, strict tenant overlay routing, per-tenant NAT and optional egress proxies.
- Private: control-plane can be either Redwood-managed in a private VPC or customer-managed (airgapped) depending on contract; KMS integration options documented.
- Auditability: audit-log pointers and retention policy references included in the index; we provide samples of sanitized logs for SOC 2 review.

Next steps: if this meets Acme's needs we can schedule a 30-min Q&A. Also offering to add a short sample KMS config for Private if you want explicit language for your procurement team.

Links to the final package:
- Drive: https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-evidence (view-only link provided to Acme)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/4331/deal/83421

Best,
Laura
